tools.description_ja: タイピングゲーム。gsap・three.js・pixi.js を使った演出つきで、Tool Registry の最初の統合例として公開しています。
tools.description: ProtoType: a heavy Vite SPA showcase (gsap + three.js + pixi.js + recharts) used as the Tool Registry pilot for Issue #81.

purpose.ja: 読み込みを開始すると、埋め込み中の ProtoType が Google Fonts / Adobe Typekit から web フォントを取得し、ログイン用 gameset が Google Apps Script のエンドポイントへ通信します（その実装は id / password をクエリ文字列に載せます）。
purpose.en: Once the load starts, the embedded ProtoType document fetches web fonts from Google Fonts and Adobe Typekit, and its login gameset calls a Google Apps Script endpoint (that implementation puts id / password in the query string).

privacy.basis: measured at pinned ProtoType 335e0e8: index.html + src/gamesets/022_Login.ts; re-measure after a bump

tools.notes: Pilot for Issue #81. Heavy Vite SPA — ~1.5MB JS bundle (gsap + three.js + pixi.js). Upstream now carries an operator-owned MIT LICENSE (added by ProtoType#4 / PR rebuildup/ProtoType#5, merge commit 335e0e8), so the previously provisional 'same operator / Berne Convention' framing is now backed by an explicit permissive license. The intermediate `--ignore-scripts` / `build.security.ignore_scripts` workaround was removed at the same time because the obfuscated `preinstall.js` lifecycle script has been deleted upstream.

tools.description_ja: PDF をブラウザ内で読むローカルファーストのリーディングアプリ。MVP は PDF 対応で、EPUB・Markdown・テキストは今後追加予定です。
tools.description: A local-first reading app for the browser. PDFs in MVP; EPUB/Markdown/text next. Designed to embed as a Tool in my-web-2026.

privacy.basis: measured at pinned readmark 8895959 (ADR-0008 storage-free redesign, merged via readmark PR #86): no external origin in index.html or src/**, and a sandboxed-frame run observed ZERO third-party requests (every request went to the serving origin; fonts.googleapis / fonts.gstatic are gone with the webfont); re-measure after a bump

tools.notes: PDF reading MVP (pdfjs-dist 5.x + React Router; Dexie removed). Uses bun as package manager. COOP/COEP headers required for SharedArrayBuffer pdfjs decode — host already serves https via rebuildup.dev canonical origin, so headers are deployable. Storage (Issue #786 / readmark ADR-0008): readmark keeps NO browser storage — documents, metadata and reading state live in a per-tab in-memory session store, and the library says so in one line. The sandboxed frame's opaque origin (every storage API denied, measured) therefore no longer matters: a reload starts an empty library by design. Zero external origins, so no consent gate.

privacy.basis: measured at pinned tool-color-palette b3fed92: no external origin in index.html or src/**; the built bundle carries only React's own react.dev error-doc URL and w3.org XML-namespace strings, which are never requested; re-measure after a bump

tools.notes: Standalone Vite build added upstream in tool-color-palette PR #6 (merge commit b3fed92): the repo now ships index.html / src/main.tsx / vite.config.ts and `bun run build` emits a static SPA into dist/. Vite base is './', so the emitted asset references stay relative and resolve under /tools/color-palette/app/. Measured at b3fed92: no external origin in index.html or src/** (no analytics, CDN or webfont fetch); the shipped bundle's only outbound host references are react.dev (React's error-documentation URL) and www.w3.org (XML namespace strings), recorded in quality/tool-artifact-inventory.json. The frame runs sandboxed without allow-same-origin (opaque origin), and the app guards every localStorage access with try/catch (src/components/ColorPaletteGenerator.tsx), so it keeps working with in-memory state there. Uses bun as package manager.

tools.description_ja: マイク入力のレベルを OBS のミキサーと同じ目盛りで表示し、5 秒のテストから -14 dBFS に近づけるゲイン調整量を提案するツール。音声はブラウザの外へ送信しません。
tools.description: Browser-only microphone level meter that mirrors the OBS Audio Mixer zones (-50 / -20 / -9 / -0.5 dBFS) and recommends a +/- dB gain delta toward -14 dBFS from a 5-second speech check. Audio never leaves the browser.

privacy.basis: measured at pinned mic-level 9506e461: the built bundle contacts no third-party origin at load time — the only absolute URLs in dist are the XML/SVG/MathML namespace identifiers (www.w3.org, never fetched), React's error-doc URL (react.dev/errors, a link inside an error message) and the OBS documentation link (obsproject.com, an <a href> the visitor has to click); the bundle's single fetch() is React's own same-origin module preload, and src/** contains no fetch / XHR / sendBeacon / WebSocket and no localStorage / sessionStorage / indexedDB, so the frame needs no storage fallback; re-measure after a bump

tools.notes: Standalone Vite build merged via rebuildup/tool-mic-level PR #4 (commit 9506e4619541d8912346648ced1239607acea199 = pinned submodule HEAD, verified with git ls-remote + submodule status). Build: bun (bun.lock present, `vite build`); LICENSE (MIT) present in the checkout. Microphone: `delivery.iframe.allow: microphone` is mirrored into the host-side Permissions-Policy grant (src/tools/registry.ts#toolRouteSecurityPolicy) and the artefact-side grant (public/_headers `/tools/mic-level/app/*`). Measured at the pin: dist = index.html 513 B + assets/index-DI3G-JcY.js 248,619 B (gzip 78.20 kB), zero third-party origins, no browser-storage usage. Measured in the host preview (2026-11-02, Chromium): the frame renders with allow="microphone" and both Permissions-Policy halves grant microphone, but the retained sandbox="allow-scripts" leaves the frame on an opaque origin (window.origin === "null"), so getUserMedia rejects with SecurityError ("Permissions policy violation: microphone is not allowed in this document"); dropping the sandbox attribute from the same frame makes the same grant resolve. The granted path therefore still waits on ADR-0020 §2.1 (no sandbox for same_origin_static, Issue #825).
